site.name: 大选择
site.description: 大选择人生选择案例库，覆盖职业、创业、城市、婚姻、房产、教育、理财、健康、时间和消费等真实决策场景。
site.description_en: The Daxuanze life choices case library, covering real decision scenarios in careers, entrepreneurship, cities, marriage, property, education, personal finance, health, time, and consumption.

usage.purpose: 给搜索引擎和联网 AI 提供可索引、可引用的中文人生选择案例。
usage.policy: 内容为教育性决策参考，不构成医疗、法律、投资或财务建议。

cases.title: 稳定平台还是高速成长公司
cases.scenario: 一名工作 5 年的产品经理同时拿到两份 offer：一家大厂薪资稳定但成长空间变窄，另一家中型 AI 公司不确定性更高但岗位权责更大。
cases.question: 职业选择应该优先稳定还是成长？
cases.analysis: 大选择的判断框架会先比较现金流安全、能力复利、行业趋势、上级质量、失败可恢复性和未来选择权。稳定平台适合现金流压力大、需要品牌背书的人；高速成长公司适合已有储备、愿意承担波动并能获得关键能力的人。
cases.decision: 如果储蓄能覆盖 12 个月生活成本，并且新岗位能显著提升核心能力，可以给成长型机会更高权重；否则先在稳定平台积累筹码。
cases.lesson: 职业选择不是只看当下工资，而是看这一步是否扩大未来选择权。
cases.title_en: Stable Platform or Fast-Growing Company
cases.scenario_en: A product manager with 5 years of experience receives two offers at the same time: a large company with stable pay but narrower room to grow, and a mid-sized AI company with higher uncertainty but a role with greater responsibility and authority.
cases.question_en: Should career choices prioritize stability or growth?
cases.analysis_en: Daxuanze's decision framework starts by comparing cash flow safety, compounding of skills, industry trends, quality of your manager, recoverability from failure, and future options. A stable platform suits people under heavy cash flow pressure who need brand endorsement; a fast-growing company suits people who already have reserves, are willing to accept volatility, and can gain key skills.
cases.decision_en: If your savings can cover 12 months of living costs and the new role can significantly improve your core skills, you can give more weight to the growth opportunity; otherwise, build up leverage first at a stable platform.
cases.lesson_en: A career choice is not just about current pay, but about whether this step expands your future options.

cases.title: 辞职创业前先做副业验证
cases.scenario: 一名运营负责人想辞职做知识付费产品，但还没有稳定客户，也没有验证获客成本。
cases.question: 什么时候适合从上班切换到创业？
cases.analysis: 创业选择要看需求验证、现金流缓冲、团队互补、获客路径和最坏结果承受能力。没有验证需求时，一次性辞职会把学习问题变成生存问题。
cases.decision: 先用 8 到 12 周做副业验证，拿到付费客户、复购反馈和获客数据后，再决定是否全职投入。
cases.lesson: 创业不是勇敢辞职，而是把不可控风险拆成可验证的小实验。
cases.title_en: Validate With a Side Project Before Quitting to Start a Business
cases.scenario_en: An operations lead wants to quit to build a knowledge-payment product, but has no stable customers yet and has not validated customer acquisition costs.
cases.question_en: When is the right time to switch from employment to entrepreneurship?
cases.analysis_en: A startup choice depends on demand validation, cash flow buffer, complementary team skills, customer acquisition path, and ability to bear the worst outcome. Without validated demand, quitting outright turns a learning problem into a survival problem.
cases.decision_en: First run an 8 to 12 week side-project validation, and only decide whether to go full-time after gaining paying customers, repeat-purchase feedback, and acquisition data.
cases.lesson_en: Starting a business is not about bravely quitting; it is about breaking uncontrollable risk into small, verifiable experiments.

cases.title: 留在一线城市还是回家乡城市
cases.scenario: 一对新婚夫妻在一线城市收入较高但买房压力大，家乡省会收入下降 25% 但有家庭支持和更低生活成本。
cases.question: 城市选择应该看收入还是生活质量？
cases.analysis: 地域选择要同时比较职业机会、住房成本、教育医疗、家庭支持、通勤压力和长期资产配置。一线城市的高收入如果被高房租、高通勤和育儿压力抵消，净收益可能并不高。
cases.decision: 把两地 5 年现金流、职业上限和家庭支持量化后再选；如果回家乡仍能保留职业成长路径，生活质量权重可以提高。
cases.lesson: 城市不是越大越好，而是要匹配人生阶段和家庭约束。
cases.title_en: Stay in a First-Tier City or Return to Your Home City
cases.scenario_en: A newly married couple earns more in a first-tier city but faces heavy pressure to buy a home; in their home provincial capital, income would fall by 25% but they would have family support and lower living costs.
cases.question_en: Should city choice be based on income or quality of life?
cases.analysis_en: A location choice should compare career opportunities, housing costs, education and healthcare, family support, commuting pressure, and long-term asset allocation at the same time. If high income in a first-tier city is offset by high rent, long commutes, and childcare pressure, the net benefit may not be high.
cases.decision_en: Quantify five-year cash flow, career ceiling, and family support in both places before choosing; if you can still preserve a career growth path after returning home, you can give quality of life more weight.
cases.lesson_en: A city is not better just because it is bigger; it needs to match your life stage and family constraints.

cases.title: 买房还是租房取决于现金流安全
cases.scenario: 一名 30 岁职场人有首付，但所在行业波动加大，买房后月供会占到家庭收入 55%。
cases.question: 买房还是继续租房怎么选？
cases.analysis: 房产选择要比较首付机会成本、月供压力、城市确定性、资产流动性和家庭需求。月供过高会降低职业试错能力，也会让一次资产选择变成长期压力。
cases.decision: 若买房后仍能保留 12 到 18 个月现金缓冲，并且城市和工作路径稳定，可以考虑买房；否则继续租房并提高储蓄和资产流动性。
cases.lesson: 买房不是天然正确，现金流安全是房产选择的底线。
cases.title_en: Buy or Rent Depends on Cash Flow Safety
cases.scenario_en: A 30-year-old professional has a down payment, but their industry has become more volatile, and buying would make mortgage payments account for 55% of household income.
cases.question_en: How should you choose between buying a home and continuing to rent?
cases.analysis_en: A property choice should compare the opportunity cost of the down payment, mortgage pressure, certainty about the city, asset liquidity, and family needs. Mortgage payments that are too high reduce your ability to experiment in your career, and turn a single asset choice into long-term pressure.
cases.decision_en: If you can still retain a cash buffer of 12 to 18 months after buying, and your city and career path are stable, you can consider buying; otherwise continue renting and increase savings and asset liquidity.
cases.lesson_en: Buying a home is not naturally the right answer; cash flow safety is the bottom line for property choices.

cases.title: 结婚前发现价值观分歧
cases.scenario: 情侣感情稳定，但在金钱观、父母边界和未来城市选择上多次冲突。
cases.question: 结婚前应该如何判断长期匹配？
cases.analysis: 婚姻选择要看冲突处理、家庭边界、金钱观、风险共担和共同成长。分歧本身不一定致命，真正的问题是能否持续讨论并形成可执行规则。
cases.decision: 把分歧写成具体议题，进行多轮现实模拟。如果关键问题只能回避，结婚决策应延后。
cases.lesson: 婚姻不是短期吸引的延长，而是长期协作系统。
cases.title_en: Discovering Conflicting Values Before Marriage
cases.scenario_en: A couple's relationship is stable, but they repeatedly clash over views on money, boundaries with parents, and choice of future city.
cases.question_en: How should you judge long-term compatibility before marriage?
cases.analysis_en: A marriage choice should look at conflict handling, family boundaries, views on money, shared risk-bearing, and growing together. Disagreement itself is not necessarily fatal; the real question is whether you can keep discussing it and form workable rules.
cases.decision_en: Write the disagreements down as specific topics and run multiple rounds of realistic simulation. If key issues can only be avoided, the marriage decision should be postponed.
cases.lesson_en: Marriage is not an extension of short-term attraction, but a long-term system of collaboration.

cases.title: 贵的学校不一定是最合适的教育选择
cases.scenario: 家长想给孩子选择高价国际学校，但孩子目前更需要稳定节奏和基础能力训练。
cases.question: 教育选择应该看学校名气还是孩子匹配度？
cases.analysis: 教育选择要比较能力复利、孩子适配、家庭现金流、路径转换空间和心理压力。高价教育如果牺牲家庭稳定或不匹配孩子状态，实际收益会下降。
cases.decision: 先评估孩子特点和家庭预算，再选择能提升能力、保护兴趣、保留转换路径的教育方案。
cases.lesson: 好的教育选择会增加未来选择权，而不是制造单一路径压力。
cases.title_en: An Expensive School Is Not Necessarily the Most Suitable Education Choice
cases.scenario_en: Parents want to choose a high-priced international school for their child, but the child currently needs a stable pace and training in foundational skills more.
cases.question_en: Should education choices be based on a school's reputation or on fit for the child?
cases.analysis_en: An education choice should compare compounding of skills, fit for the child, family cash flow, room to change paths, and psychological pressure. High-priced education will deliver less in practice if it sacrifices family stability or does not match the child's state.
cases.decision_en: First assess the child's characteristics and the family budget, then choose a plan that improves skills, protects interests, and preserves options to change paths.
cases.lesson_en: A good education choice increases future options, rather than creating pressure to follow a single path.

cases.title: 高收益理财前先问最坏结果
cases.scenario: 一名投资者看到高收益产品，希望用家庭备用金参与，但对底层资产和退出机制了解不足。
cases.question: 理财选择为什么不能只看收益率？
cases.analysis: 理财选择要先看风险承受能力、流动性、底层资产、最坏结果和个人时间成本。备用金承担的是安全功能，不适合追逐不透明高收益。
cases.decision: 先保留家庭备用金，再用可承受亏损的资金做分散配置；看不懂的产品不应重仓。
cases.lesson: 理财决策的第一原则不是收益最大化，而是活得够久、现金流不断。
cases.title_en: Before High-Return Financial Products, Ask About the Worst Outcome
cases.scenario_en: An investor sees a high-return product and wants to use the family's emergency fund to take part, but does not understand enough about the underlying assets and exit mechanism.
cases.question_en: Why can't financial choices be based only on returns?
cases.analysis_en: A financial choice should first look at risk tolerance, liquidity, underlying assets, the worst outcome, and your own time cost. An emergency fund serves a safety function and is not suitable for chasing opaque high returns.
cases.decision_en: First preserve the family's emergency fund, then diversify with money you can afford to lose; products you do not understand should not be held in large positions.
cases.lesson_en: The first principle of financial decisions is not maximising returns, but living long enough and keeping cash flow intact.

cases.title: 高薪工作与健康消耗的取舍
cases.scenario: 一名管理者收入很高，但长期睡眠不足、体检指标恶化，继续升职会进一步压缩恢复时间。
cases.question: 健康和事业冲突时怎么选择？
cases.analysis: 健康是所有选择的底层资产。事业收益如果持续透支健康，长期会降低工作能力、家庭关系和未来选择权。
cases.decision: 先设定健康止损线，重新谈判工作边界或调整岗位节奏；如果无法恢复基本健康，应降低事业权重。
cases.lesson: 健康不是事业之外的变量，而是事业复利的基础。
cases.title_en: The Trade-Off Between a High-Paying Job and Damage to Your Health
cases.scenario_en: A manager earns a very high income, but has long suffered from insufficient sleep and worsening physical examination indicators, and a further promotion would compress recovery time even more.
cases.question_en: How should you choose when health and career conflict?
cases.analysis_en: Health is the underlying asset behind all choices. If career gains continually overdraw your health, over the long term they will reduce your ability to work, your family relationships, and your future options.
cases.decision_en: First set a health stop-loss line, renegotiate work boundaries or adjust the pace of the role; if basic health cannot be restored, lower the weight given to career.
cases.lesson_en: Health is not a variable outside your career, but the foundation for career compounding.

cases.title: 时间选择决定能力复利
cases.scenario: 一名年轻职场人每天把下班时间分散在短视频、社交和碎片娱乐上，但又焦虑自己没有成长。
cases.question: 时间管理本质上是什么选择？
cases.analysis: 时间管理不是把日程排满，而是把有限注意力投向长期有复利的事情。娱乐不是问题，问题是没有给核心能力留下固定投入。
cases.decision: 每周固定 5 到 8 小时投入一个能产生作品、技能或资产的方向，并减少低价值碎片消耗。
cases.lesson: 时间选择会把今天的注意力变成未来的能力差距。
cases.title_en: Time Choices Determine How Skills Compound
cases.scenario_en: A young professional spends their time after work scattered across short videos, socialising, and fragmented entertainment every day, yet feels anxious that they are not growing.
cases.question_en: What choice is time management essentially about?
cases.analysis_en: Time management is not about filling up your schedule, but about directing limited attention toward things that compound over the long term. Entertainment is not the problem; the problem is leaving no fixed investment for core skills.
cases.decision_en: Set aside a fixed 5 to 8 hours each week for one direction that can produce work, skills, or assets, and reduce low-value fragmented consumption.
cases.lesson_en: Time choices turn today's attention into tomorrow's gap in ability.

cases.title: 买车还是保留现金流
cases.scenario: 一名刚工作三年的年轻人想买车提升生活体验，但车辆支出会消耗大部分储蓄。
cases.question: 大额消费如何判断是否值得？
cases.analysis: 消费选择要比较使用频率、替代方案、维护成本、现金流压力和长期价值。如果消费降低了抗风险能力，它的真实成本高于标价。
cases.decision: 先估算一年总拥有成本和使用场景。如果公共交通或租车能满足主要需求，可以延后购买，把现金留给更高优先级目标。
cases.lesson: 消费决策的核心是价值匹配，不是便宜或昂贵本身。
cases.title_en: Buy a Car or Preserve Cash Flow
cases.scenario_en: A young person who has worked for three years wants to buy a car to improve their quality of life, but the car expenses would consume most of their savings.
cases.question_en: How should you judge whether a large purchase is worth it?
cases.analysis_en: A consumption choice should compare frequency of use, alternatives, maintenance costs, cash flow pressure, and long-term value. If consumption lowers your resilience to risk, its real cost is higher than the sticker price.
cases.decision_en: First estimate the total cost of ownership for a year and the usage scenarios. If public transport or renting a car can meet your main needs, you can postpone the purchase and keep the cash for higher-priority goals.
cases.lesson_en: The core of consumption decisions is matching value, not cheapness or expensiveness itself.

cases.title: 人际关系也需要机会成本
cases.scenario: 一名创业者把大量时间投入低质量社交，真正重要的客户、家人和核心团队反而被忽视。
cases.question: 如何选择值得投入的人际关系？
cases.analysis: 人际关系选择要看信任、互惠、成长、情绪成本和长期协作价值。不是所有社交都值得投入，关系也占用时间和注意力。
cases.decision: 减少消耗型关系，把固定时间留给家庭、关键合作伙伴和能长期互相增益的人。
cases.lesson: 关系选择不是功利，而是承认注意力有限。
cases.title_en: Relationships Also Have an Opportunity Cost
cases.scenario_en: A founder spends a lot of time on low-quality socialising, while truly important customers, family, and core team members are neglected instead.
cases.question_en: How should you choose which relationships are worth investing in?
cases.analysis_en: A relationship choice should look at trust, reciprocity, growth, emotional cost, and long-term collaboration value. Not all socialising is worth investing in, and relationships also take up time and attention.
cases.decision_en: Reduce draining relationships, and reserve fixed time for family, key partners, and people who can mutually benefit each other over the long term.
cases.lesson_en: Choosing relationships is not about being calculating, but about acknowledging that attention is limited.

cases.title: 提前退休前先验证现金流
cases.scenario: 一名 40 岁高收入人群希望提前退休，但资产主要集中在房产，流动现金流不足。
cases.question: 提前退休应该先看什么？
cases.analysis: 退休规划要看可持续现金流、资产流动性、健康支出、家庭责任和生活方式成本。资产净值高不等于退休安全。
cases.decision: 先建立可覆盖基础生活的现金流组合，再做 3 到 5 年压力测试，确认极端情况下不被迫出售核心资产。
cases.lesson: 退休选择不是离开工作，而是现金流能支持长期自由。
cases.title_en: Validate Cash Flow Before Retiring Early
cases.scenario_en: A 40-year-old high earner hopes to retire early, but their assets are mainly concentrated in property and liquid cash flow is insufficient.
cases.question_en: What should you look at first for early retirement?
cases.analysis_en: Retirement planning should look at sustainable cash flow, asset liquidity, health spending, family responsibilities, and lifestyle costs. A high net worth does not equal retirement safety.
cases.decision_en: First build a cash flow portfolio that can cover basic living, then run a 3 to 5 year stress test to confirm you will not be forced to sell core assets in extreme circumstances.
cases.lesson_en: A retirement choice is not about leaving work, but about whether cash flow can support long-term freedom.

cases.title: 考研还是先工作要看目标岗位门槛
cases.scenario: 一名大四学生同时拿到普通公司的 offer，也有机会继续考研。家人认为学历越高越好，但他担心再读三年会错过行业机会。
cases.question: 考研还是工作应该怎么选择？
cases.analysis: 大选择会先判断目标岗位是否存在硬性学历门槛，再比较时间成本、机会成本、家庭现金流、个人学习状态和行业窗口期。如果目标行业明确要求研究生学历，考研是在补入场券；如果行业更看重作品、项目和实践，先工作可能更快形成能力复利。
cases.decision: 先列出三个目标岗位，查清学历要求和真实招聘标准。若研究生学历能显著提高进入目标赛道的概率，可以投入考研；若岗位主要看项目经验，应优先选择能积累作品和行业经验的工作。
cases.lesson: 考研不是逃避就业的默认选项，工作也不是放弃成长；关键是这一步是否提高目标路径的进入概率。
cases.title_en: Postgraduate Exams or Work First Depends on the Threshold for Your Target Role
cases.scenario_en: A final-year student receives an offer from an ordinary company and also has the chance to continue preparing for postgraduate entrance exams. Their family believes the higher the qualification the better, but they worry that studying for another three years will mean missing industry opportunities.
cases.question_en: How should you choose between postgraduate exams and work?
cases.analysis_en: Daxuanze first judges whether the target role has a hard qualification threshold, then compares time cost, opportunity cost, family cash flow, personal study state, and the industry window. If the target industry explicitly requires a postgraduate degree, the exam is about obtaining an entry ticket; if the industry values work, projects, and practice more, working first may build compounding skills faster.
cases.decision_en: First list three target roles and check their qualification requirements and real hiring standards. If a postgraduate degree can significantly increase the probability of entering your target track, you can invest in the exam; if roles mainly look at project experience, prioritize work that builds a portfolio and industry experience.
cases.lesson_en: Postgraduate exams are not a default option for avoiding employment, and work is not giving up on growth; the key is whether this step increases the probability of entering your target path.

cases.title: 留学还是国内发展要算路径回报
cases.scenario: 一名本科毕业生收到海外硕士录取，学费和生活费需要家庭投入较大资金；同时国内也有一份成长型岗位机会。
cases.question: 留学还是留在国内发展怎么选？
cases.analysis: 留学选择要比较专业含金量、目标国家就业政策、语言和适应能力、家庭现金流、毕业后的行业位置以及回国认可度。留学不是天然升级，只有当它能带来明确能力、网络或职业准入优势时，投入才更容易转化为选择权。
cases.decision: 把留学项目、国内岗位和未来三年目标放在同一张表里比较。若海外项目能明显进入更高质量平台且家庭现金流安全，可以选择留学；若项目普通且回报不清晰，应优先国内积累经验或选择成本更低的进修路径。
cases.lesson: 教育投资的核心不是地点，而是这段经历能否扩大长期选择权。
cases.title_en: Studying Abroad or Developing at Home Requires Calculating Path Returns
cases.scenario_en: An undergraduate graduate receives an offer for an overseas master's, with tuition and living costs requiring a large investment from the family; at the same time there is also a growth-oriented job opportunity at home.
cases.question_en: How should you choose between studying abroad and staying in China to develop your career?
cases.analysis_en: A study-abroad choice should compare the quality of the programme, employment policy in the target country, language and adaptability, family cash flow, industry position after graduation, and recognition after returning home. Studying abroad is not automatically an upgrade; only when it brings clear advantages in skills, networks, or professional access is the investment more likely to turn into future options.
cases.decision_en: Put the overseas programme, the domestic job, and your goals for the next three years in the same table for comparison. If the overseas programme clearly gives access to a higher-quality platform and family cash flow is safe, you can choose to study abroad; if the programme is ordinary and returns are unclear, prioritize gaining experience at home or choose a lower-cost path for further study.
cases.lesson_en: The core of education investment is not location, but whether the experience can expand your long-term options.
keywords_en: Study abroad or stay in China

cases.title: 要不要分手看问题能否被修复
cases.scenario: 一对情侣感情基础不错，但反复因为消费观、沟通方式和未来城市规划争吵。双方都很痛苦，却又舍不得结束关系。
cases.question: 恋爱关系中要不要分手怎么判断？
cases.analysis: 亲密关系选择要区分可修复问题和结构性问题。情绪表达、生活习惯可以通过规则和练习改善；价值观、尊重边界、重大人生目标长期冲突，则会持续消耗。判断重点不是有没有矛盾，而是双方是否愿意面对矛盾并形成新行为。
cases.decision: 给关系设定 4 到 8 周修复实验，明确三个具体问题、可观察行为和复盘时间。若双方都能稳定改变，可以继续；若反复逃避、攻击或否认问题，分手可能是降低长期损耗的选择。
cases.lesson: 分手不是只看还爱不爱，而是看这段关系是否仍能支持双方成为更好的人。
cases.title_en: Whether to Break Up Depends on Whether the Problems Can Be Repaired
cases.scenario_en: A couple has a good foundation, but repeatedly argues over views on spending, communication style, and future city plans. Both are in pain, yet reluctant to end the relationship.
cases.question_en: How should you judge whether to break up in a romantic relationship?
cases.analysis_en: An intimate relationship choice should distinguish between repairable problems and structural problems. Emotional expression and living habits can be improved through rules and practice; long-term conflict over values, respect for boundaries, and major life goals will keep draining you. The focus of judgement is not whether there is conflict, but whether both sides are willing to face the conflict and form new behavior.
cases.decision_en: Set a 4 to 8 week repair experiment for the relationship, specifying three concrete problems, observable behaviors, and a review time. If both can change steadily, you can continue; if they repeatedly avoid, attack, or deny the problems, breaking up may be the choice that reduces long-term drain.
cases.lesson_en: Breaking up is not only about whether you still love each other, but about whether the relationship can still support both people in becoming better.

cases.title: 父母反对婚姻时先拆开反对理由
cases.scenario: 情侣准备结婚，但父母强烈反对，理由包括对方家庭条件、地域距离和性格担忧。双方陷入父母意见和个人选择之间的拉扯。
cases.question: 父母反对婚姻应该听父母还是坚持自己？
cases.analysis: 婚姻选择不能简单归为听父母或反抗父母，而要拆解反对理由是否基于真实风险。经济责任、家庭边界、冲突处理和长期生活规划需要被验证；面子、偏见或控制欲则不能成为替代个人判断的理由。
cases.decision: 把父母反对点写成清单，逐项验证事实和风险。能通过沟通、协议和边界管理解决的，推动具体方案；涉及暴力、失信、严重价值观冲突等硬风险的，应暂停结婚决策。
cases.lesson: 婚姻选择需要尊重父母经验，但最终要由可验证的长期协作能力来决定。
cases.title_en: When Parents Oppose a Marriage, First Break Down Their Reasons
cases.scenario_en: A couple is preparing to marry, but the parents strongly oppose it, for reasons including the other family's conditions, geographic distance, and concerns about character. Both are caught between parental opinion and personal choice.
cases.question_en: When parents oppose a marriage, should you listen to them or stick to your own choice?
cases.analysis_en: A marriage choice cannot simply be reduced to listening to parents or rebelling against them; you need to break down whether their reasons are based on real risks. Economic responsibility, family boundaries, conflict handling, and long-term life planning need to be verified; face, prejudice, or a desire for control cannot substitute for personal judgement.
cases.decision_en: Write the parents' objections into a checklist and verify the facts and risks item by item. For issues that can be resolved through communication, agreements, and boundary management, push for concrete plans; for hard risks such as violence, dishonesty, or serious conflicts in values, postpone the marriage decision.
cases.lesson_en: Marriage choices need to respect parents' experience, but ultimately should be decided by verifiable ability to collaborate over the long term.

cases.title: 35岁转型要先保留现金流和可迁移能力
cases.scenario: 一名 35 岁职场人所在行业增长放缓，想转到 AI 或新消费领域，但担心年龄、收入下降和重新开始的风险。
cases.question: 35岁职业转型应该冒险吗？
cases.analysis: 中年职业转型要同时看现金流安全、可迁移能力、目标行业真实需求、学习速度和家庭责任。盲目裸辞转型风险很高，但完全不动也可能让未来选择权继续缩小。更优解通常是小步验证。
cases.decision: 先盘点可迁移能力，选择相邻岗位或相邻行业切入，用 3 到 6 个月做作品、项目或副业验证。现金流能覆盖 12 个月且已有明确机会时，再考虑更大幅度切换。
cases.lesson: 35岁转型不是重新做人，而是把已有经验迁移到更有未来的位置。
cases.title_en: Changing Careers at 35: First Preserve Cash Flow and Transferable Skills
cases.scenario_en: A 35-year-old professional's industry is slowing in growth, and they want to move into AI or new consumer fields, but worry about age, falling income, and the risk of starting over.
cases.question_en: Should you take risks when changing careers at 35?
cases.analysis_en: A mid-career change should look at cash flow safety, transferable skills, real demand in the target industry, learning speed, and family responsibilities at the same time. Quitting blindly to change careers is very risky, but not moving at all may also keep shrinking your future options. The better solution is usually small-step validation.
cases.decision_en: First take stock of transferable skills, choose an adjacent role or adjacent industry to enter, and use 3 to 6 months for portfolio, project, or side-project validation. When cash flow can cover 12 months and there is a clear opportunity, consider a larger switch.
cases.lesson_en: Changing careers at 35 is not about becoming a new person, but about moving your existing experience to a position with more future.

cases.title: 钱多但不喜欢和喜欢但钱少要分阶段选择
cases.scenario: 一名年轻人有两个选择：高薪岗位压力大且不喜欢，另一份工作更感兴趣但收入低很多。
cases.question: 钱多但不喜欢的工作和喜欢但钱少的工作怎么选？
cases.analysis: 职业选择要看人生阶段。现金流脆弱时，高薪能提供安全垫和试错资本；长期消耗严重时，兴趣和能力匹配会影响复利。关键不是把钱和热爱对立，而是看哪条路能在当前阶段增加未来选择。
cases.decision: 如果储蓄不足、家庭责任重，先选择高薪但设定止损期，同时积累转向喜欢方向的能力；如果现金流安全且低薪岗位有明确成长曲线，可以给兴趣和能力匹配更高权重。
cases.lesson: 理想的职业选择不是只追钱或只追热爱，而是让现金流和能力复利在阶段上配合。
cases.title_en: High Pay You Dislike vs Low Pay You Love: Choose in Stages
cases.scenario_en: A young person has two choices: a high-paying role with heavy pressure that they do not like, and another job they are more interested in but that pays much less.
cases.question_en: How should you choose between a job that pays well but you dislike, and a job you love that pays less?
cases.analysis_en: Career choices depend on life stage. When cash flow is fragile, high pay can provide a safety cushion and capital to experiment; when the drain is severe over the long term, interest and skill fit will affect compounding. The key is not to set money and passion against each other, but to see which path increases future choices at the current stage.
cases.decision_en: If savings are insufficient and family responsibilities are heavy, first choose the high-paying job but set a stop-loss period, while building skills to move toward the direction you love; if cash flow is safe and the low-paying role has a clear growth curve, you can give more weight to interest and skill fit.
cases.lesson_en: An ideal career choice is not only chasing money or only chasing passion, but making cash flow and skill compounding work together at each stage.
keywords_en: Pays well but you dislike it
You love it but it pays less

cases.title: 是否离开当前公司要看问题来自岗位还是周期
cases.scenario: 一名员工在当前公司已经三年，觉得成长停滞、领导支持有限，但外部环境也不稳定，跳槽机会并不确定。
cases.question: 要不要离开当前公司怎么判断？
cases.analysis: 离职选择要区分公司问题、岗位问题、领导问题和个人成长瓶颈。如果核心问题可通过内部转岗、换项目或重新谈目标解决，马上离开未必最优；如果平台、上级和行业都在降低未来选择权，则需要主动寻找出口。
cases.decision: 先做 60 天内部修复实验：争取新项目、明确晋升标准、扩大外部面试样本。若内部没有改善且外部机会能提升能力或平台，再离开；否则先稳住现金流并继续找更高质量机会。
cases.lesson: 离职不是情绪出口，而是一次关于未来选择权的资产再配置。
cases.title_en: Whether to Leave Your Current Company Depends on Whether the Problem Is the Role or the Cycle
cases.scenario_en: An employee has been at their current company for three years, feels growth has stalled and manager support is limited, but the external environment is also unstable and job change opportunities are uncertain.
cases.question_en: How should you judge whether to leave your current company?
cases.analysis_en: A resignation choice should distinguish between company problems, role problems, manager problems, and personal growth bottlenecks. If the core problem can be solved through an internal transfer, a change of project, or renegotiating goals, leaving immediately may not be optimal; if the platform, manager, and industry are all reducing your future options, you need to actively look for an exit.
cases.decision_en: First run a 60-day internal repair experiment: seek new projects, clarify promotion criteria, and expand your sample of external interviews. If there is no internal improvement and an external opportunity can improve your skills or platform, leave; otherwise stabilise cash flow first and keep looking for higher-quality opportunities.
cases.lesson_en: Leaving a job is not an emotional outlet, but a reallocation of assets concerning your future options.

cases.title: 要不要生孩子要看家庭系统准备度
cases.scenario: 一对夫妻感情稳定，但工作压力、住房成本和老人支持都不确定。双方想要孩子，却担心生育后生活质量下降。
cases.question: 要不要生孩子或者要不要二胎怎么选择？
cases.analysis: 生育选择不是单点决定，而是家庭系统决策。需要同时评估夫妻关系、现金流、照护资源、职业影响、住房空间、教育预期和心理准备。只靠情绪或外部催促，很容易低估长期责任。
cases.decision: 先做三年家庭压力测试：收入下降、照护缺口、教育支出和职业中断分别如何应对。若夫妻能形成清晰分工和现金缓冲，可以推进；若核心责任无法落地，应先补足系统条件。
cases.lesson: 生育选择的关键不是别人什么时候生，而是自己的家庭系统能否承接长期责任。
cases.title_en: Whether to Have a Child Depends on How Ready Your Family System Is
cases.scenario_en: A couple's relationship is stable, but work pressure, housing costs, and support from elderly parents are all uncertain. Both want a child, but worry that quality of life will fall after having one.
cases.question_en: How should you choose whether to have a child, or whether to have a second child?
cases.analysis_en: A childbearing choice is not a single-point decision, but a family system decision. You need to assess the couple's relationship, cash flow, care resources, career impact, housing space, education expectations, and psychological readiness at the same time. Relying only on emotion or external urging makes it easy to underestimate long-term responsibility.
cases.decision_en: First run a three-year family stress test: how would you handle falling income, care gaps, education spending, and career interruption respectively? If the couple can form clear division of labour and a cash buffer, you can proceed; if core responsibilities cannot be put in place, first build up the system conditions.
cases.lesson_en: The key to a childbearing choice is not when other people have children, but whether your own family system can take on long-term responsibility.
keywords_en: Whether to have a second child

cases.title: 是否回老家照顾父母要设计双城方案
cases.scenario: 独生子女在大城市工作稳定，父母年纪增长需要更多陪伴和照顾。回老家会降低收入，不回去又有内疚和现实照护压力。
cases.question: 为了照顾父母要不要回老家？
cases.analysis: 这类地域选择同时包含亲情责任、职业机会、医疗资源、家庭分工和长期现金流。二选一往往过于粗糙，更现实的是设计阶段性方案和照护网络。
cases.decision: 先评估父母健康等级、当地医疗资源和可替代照护支持。可以尝试远程安排、定期返乡、父母短住城市或阶段性回流；只有当照护需求持续且不可外包时，再考虑长期回老家。
cases.lesson: 照顾父母不是只有牺牲职业一条路，好的选择要同时保护亲情责任和长期生存能力。
cases.title_en: Whether to Return to Your Hometown to Care for Parents: Design a Two-City Plan
cases.scenario_en: An only child has stable work in a big city, while their parents are getting older and need more companionship and care. Returning home would reduce income, but not returning brings guilt and real care pressure.
cases.question_en: Should you return to your hometown to care for your parents?
cases.analysis_en: This type of location choice involves family responsibility, career opportunities, medical resources, family division of labour, and long-term cash flow at the same time. A binary choice is often too crude; a more realistic approach is to design phased plans and a care network.
cases.decision_en: First assess your parents' health level, local medical resources, and alternative care support available. You can try remote arrangements, regular returns home, parents staying in the city for short periods, or phased return; only when care needs are sustained and cannot be outsourced should you consider returning home long-term.
cases.lesson_en: Caring for parents does not only have the path of sacrificing your career; a good choice should protect both family responsibility and long-term ability to sustain yourself.
keywords_en: Returning home to care for parents

cases.title: 高考志愿专业选择要平衡兴趣和就业面
cases.scenario: 学生喜欢文史类专业，但家长担心就业；热门工科专业就业更稳，但学生兴趣一般，担心大学四年很痛苦。
cases.question: 大学专业应该选兴趣还是就业？
cases.analysis: 专业选择要比较兴趣强度、能力匹配、就业面、转专业空间、城市资源和未来复合路径。兴趣可以提高投入质量，但就业面决定毕业后的选择空间；两者不是只能选一边。
cases.decision: 优先选择兴趣不排斥、就业面足够宽、未来可复合的专业或院校组合。若兴趣专业就业窄，应提前设计辅修、实习和技能组合；若热门专业完全不适配，也不应只因热门而选择。
cases.lesson: 专业选择不是预测一生，而是选择一个能打开更多后续路径的起点。
cases.title_en: Choosing a University Major in the Gaokao Application: Balance Interest and Employment Breadth
cases.scenario_en: A student likes humanities and history majors, but parents worry about employment; popular engineering majors offer more stable employment, but the student has only average interest and worries about suffering through four years at university.
cases.question_en: Should you choose a university major based on interest or employment?
cases.analysis_en: A major choice should compare strength of interest, skill fit, employment breadth, room to change majors, city resources, and future combined paths. Interest can improve the quality of engagement, but employment breadth determines the choice space after graduation; the two are not mutually exclusive.
cases.decision_en: Prioritise majors or university combinations that you do not dislike, that have sufficiently wide employment prospects, and that can be combined in the future. If an interest major has narrow employment, design minors, internships, and skill combinations in advance; if a popular major is a complete mismatch, you should not choose it only because it is popular.
cases.lesson_en: Choosing a major is not predicting a whole lifetime, but choosing a starting point that opens more subsequent paths.

cases.title: 降薪换成长要看成长是否可兑现
cases.scenario: 一名职场人遇到一个降薪 20% 的机会，但岗位能接触核心业务和优秀团队。原岗位收入更高，却重复性强。
cases.question: 要不要接受降薪换成长？
cases.analysis: 降薪换成长不是口号，必须验证成长是否具体可兑现。要看新岗位的职责边界、上级质量、业务空间、能力增量和未来议价权。如果只是画饼，降薪会同时损失现金流和时间。
cases.decision: 把成长拆成可验证指标：负责什么项目、获得什么能力、接触什么资源、多久能提高市场价值。若这些指标明确且现金流能承受，可以接受有限期降薪；否则不要用确定收入换不确定承诺。
cases.lesson: 值得降薪的成长，必须能转化为未来更强的选择权和议价权。
cases.title_en: Taking a Pay Cut for Growth Depends on Whether the Growth Can Be Realised
cases.scenario_en: A professional encounters an opportunity with a 20% pay cut, but the role would give access to core business and an excellent team. Their original role pays more, but is highly repetitive.
cases.question_en: Should you accept a pay cut in exchange for growth?
cases.analysis_en: A pay cut for growth is not a slogan; you must verify whether the growth is concrete and realisable. Look at the new role's responsibility boundaries, manager quality, business scope, skill gains, and future bargaining power. If it is just empty promises, a pay cut will lose both cash flow and time.
cases.decision_en: Break growth into verifiable indicators: what projects you will be responsible for, what skills you will gain, what resources you will access, and how long it will take to increase your market value. If these indicators are clear and cash flow can bear it, you can accept a time-limited pay cut; otherwise do not trade certain income for uncertain promises.
cases.lesson_en: Growth worth a pay cut must be able to turn into stronger future options and bargaining power.

cases.title: 创业合伙前先谈退出和分工
cases.scenario: 两个朋友想一起创业，一个负责产品，一个负责销售。项目还没开始盈利，但双方已经准备平均分股。
cases.question: 要不要和朋友合伙创业？
cases.analysis: 合伙创业要先看能力互补、投入强度、决策机制、股权归属、退出规则和冲突处理。友情能降低初始信任成本，但不能替代商业契约。没有规则的平均分配，后期很容易变成冲突来源。
cases.decision: 在正式合伙前写清楚投入时间、资金责任、关键岗位、股权成熟期、重大事项表决和退出机制。若这些问题无法公开讨论，不适合立刻合伙。
cases.lesson: 好的创业合伙不是关系好，而是能把风险、权责和退出机制提前讲清楚。
cases.title_en: Before Partnering in a Startup, Talk About Exit and Division of Labour First
cases.scenario_en: Two friends want to start a business together, one responsible for product and one for sales. The project has not started making a profit yet, but both are already preparing to split equity equally.
cases.question_en: Should you partner with a friend to start a business?
cases.analysis_en: Partnering in a startup should first look at complementary skills, intensity of commitment, decision mechanisms, equity ownership, exit rules, and conflict handling. Friendship can lower initial trust costs, but cannot replace a business contract. Equal distribution without rules easily becomes a source of conflict later.
cases.decision_en: Before formally partnering, write clearly the time committed, financial responsibilities, key roles, equity vesting period, voting on major matters, and exit mechanism. If these issues cannot be discussed openly, it is not suitable to partner immediately.
cases.lesson_en: A good startup partnership is not about having a good relationship, but about being able to clarify risks, rights and responsibilities, and exit mechanisms in advance.
keywords_en: Partnering with friends to start a business
